WireGuardPeersByUserHelp: Lists each user's peers against what their groups give.
WireGuardPresharedKeysHelp: Adds a second key to each peer. Peers need new configs after a change.
WireGuardPrivateKeyHelp: Leave blank to keep the saved key or make a new one.
WireGuardPublicEndpointHelp: Sets the name or address peers connect to, with an optional port.
WireGuardPublicKeyHelp: Leave blank to make a new key pair.
WireGuardQrLabel: QR code of the peer configuration
WireGuardRestartHelp: Stops every tunnel and starts them again. Peers reconnect on their own.
WireGuardRoutedSubnetsHelp: Leave blank unless the peer is a router that does not NAT.
WireGuardSidecarHelp: Downloads wireguard-go for this server again and restarts the tunnels with it.
WireGuardSidecarMissing: Not downloaded. Version {0} for {1} downloads when WireGuard is turned on.
WireGuardSidecarNoPlatform: No wireguard-go is built for this server's platform.
WireGuardTunnelSubnetHelp: Sets the peers' addresses, which must not overlap your network.
WireGuardWarnNoSidecar: wireguard-go is not downloaded. Download it in Settings to run WireGuard.
